name: qoe.fi
description: qoe.fi monorepo — Turborepo + pnpm + Next.js (web, console) + Hono (api) + BullMQ (workers)

scripts.dev: node scripts/copy-env.js && pnpm intl:compile && turbo run dev --parallel
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/copy-env.js && pnpm intl:compile && turbo run dev --filter=@qoe/web... --parallel
scripts.dev:feed: node scripts/copy-env.js && pnpm intl:compile && turbo run dev --filter=@qoe/feed... --parallel
scripts.dev:landing: node scripts/copy-env.js && pnpm intl:compile && turbo run dev --filter=@qoe/landing... --parallel
scripts.dev:admin: node scripts/copy-env.js && pnpm intl:compile && turbo run dev --filter=@qoe/admin... --parallel
scripts.dev:dashboard: node scripts/copy-env.js && pnpm intl:compile && turbo run dev --filter=@qoe/dashboard... --parallel
scripts.docker:dev:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.docker:dev:shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec feed sh
scripts.docker:dev:db: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec db psql -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-qoe} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-qoe}
scripts.docker:dev:redis: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec redis redis-cli
scripts.docker:prod:web: docker compose build --target web && docker compose up -d web
scripts.docker:prod:landing: docker compose build --target landing && docker compose up -d landing
scripts.docker:prod:feed: docker compose build --target feed && docker compose up -d feed
scripts.docker:prod:dashboard: docker compose build --target dashboard && docker compose up -d dashboard
scripts.docker:prod:admin: docker compose build --target admin && docker compose up -d admin
scripts.docker:prod:workers: docker compose build --target workers && docker compose up -d workers
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd packages/db && pnpm prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:seed: cd packages/db && pnpm prisma db seed
